note: Pinned to a commit on the default branch rather than a tag, so the probe compares against that branch tip.

The lockfile pins every plugin at a commit, and lazy.nvim's own update checker is enabled for the workstation profile, so Neovim reports a newer plugin in the editor and :Lazy update writes the new lazy-lock.json through the Stow symlink into the checkout.

Upstream stopped publishing a macOS build after this release: 3.2.0-1092 ships netcoredbg-linux-amd64.tar.gz and netcoredbg-win64.zip and no osx asset under any name, so this pin reports BEHIND and cannot move until macOS builds resume.
The pin is an OCaml compiler version resolved through opam, not a ref in a git repository; opam switch list on a machine with opam is what reads it.

The pin is a container manifest digest, read the same way as validation-image-fedora and not readable here for the same reason. It also pins a snapshot of the moving :latest tag, so "newer" is whatever that tag points at today rather than a release.

The pin is a PowerShell Gallery module version, stated in the workflow step that installs it and enforced by tests/test-windows-static-analysis.ps1; this report reads a shell-style key="value" assignment out of a tracked file, which neither a YAML step nor a PowerShell assignment can spell, so a newer analyser is taken deliberately rather than reported here.

The pin is a container manifest digest. Reading the current one needs a registry token exchange and a manifest HEAD against two further hosts, which is a bigger mechanism than the rest of this report.
